# Project Design Context — KSK VASU & Co.

Updated with **21st.dev UI Design System** on 2026-10-31.

## Project
- **Name:** KSK VASU & Co.
- **Product Type:** Construction Materials Supplier & Earth Moving Machinery Contractor
- **Stack:** HTML5, CSS3 (Light Mode Design Tokens), Vanilla JavaScript, Firebase Hosting
- **Color Mode:** **Light Mode Only**
- **Density:** Comfortable

## Design System & Tokens
- **Primary:** `#0284c7` (Ocean Blue — engineering, trust, reliability)
- **Primary Hover:** `#0369a1`
- **Secondary:** `#d97706` (Terracotta / Clay brick amber)
- **Success:** `#10b981` (Live dispatch indicator, in-stock badges)
- **Surfaces:** Pure White `#ffffff` cards, `#f8fafc` background page, `#f1f5f9` subtle surfaces
- **Typography:** `Poppins` (Headings & Brand), `Inter` (Body & Data values)
- **Border:** `#e2e8f0` crisp hairlines

## Integrated 21st Design Templates
1. **Glassmorphism Light Header & Navbar:** Fixed translucent glass header with brand badges and live call action.
2. **Mobile Off-Canvas Drawer:** Fast slide-out navigation with app badge and direct order actions.
3. **Live Announcement Marquee Ribbon:** High-contrast light ticker with Tamil invocation and site highlights.
4. **Bento Hero Section:** Bold typographic headline, dual CTAs, trust ratings, and live yard status card.
5. **Key Figures & Metrics Counter Strip:** Elevated stat counters for years of trust and deliveries.
6. **Services Bento Grid:** 6 comprehensive service cards with custom icons and action links.
7. **Product Catalog Showcase with Category Filters:** Live category filter tabs (`All`, `Bricks`, `Cement`, `Sand`) with specs chips.
8. **Interactive Material Calculator:** Client-side estimator for bricks, Dalmia cement bags, and M-Sand tons.
9. **Why Choose Us / Advantage Bento Matrix:** 4 core competitive advantages.
10. **3-Step Process Timeline:** Clear order-to-delivery progression.
11. **Official Mobile Application Showcase Card:** Google Play banner, QR code, and feature chips.
12. **Customer Reviews & Testimonials Grid:** 5-star builder and engineer reviews.
13. **FAQ Accordion:** 5 expandable common customer questions.
14. **Contact & Yard Location Consultation Hub:** 4 interactive contact cards and instant WhatsApp quote form.
15. **Universal Sticky Bottom CTA:** Auto-revealing floating order action bar.
16. **Developer Portfolio Showcase:** Dedicated section on the main site and complete light-mode redesign of `developer.html`.
17. **Modern Light Footer:** Directory, social links, legal notices, and copyright.

## Constraints
- **Must:** 100% Light mode only across all pages; high sunlight legibility; mobile-first responsiveness.
- **Avoid:** Dark backgrounds or inverted dark mode overrides.
